newsitem.title: USA: Orbital raises $20.6 mln in equity capital.
newsitem.headline: Orbital raises $20.6 mln in equity capital.

text.p: Orbital Sciences Corp said on Friday it completed a private issuance of 1.2 million shares of its common stock in December 1996, generating net proceeds of about $20.6 million.
The company said it intended to use proceeds to increase its investment in ORBIMAGE, its satellite imagery business.
Orbital also said its debt-to-equity ratio was significantly reduced in 1996.

At the end of the year, it said it had about $70 million in total debt and about $330 million in total stockholders' equity, compared to about $110 million in total debt and $240 million in total stockholders' equity at the end of 1995.
It said its debt-to-equity ratio was reduced to about 20 percent at the end of 1996 from 46 percent at the end of 1995.
